title: hieracium chondrillifolium subsp. melananthodes
intro: Hieracium chondrillifolium subsp. melananthodes, commonly known as a member of the dandelion family, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic use in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its pharmacological actions. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic actions and health benefits of Hieracium chondrillifolium subsp. melananthodes.
